source.rule: Two same-type mother systems can have distinct PLINDs, each pointing through PrelifeStructure to a different child PLID so initially installed same-type items receive different ages.

hypothesis_before_native.age20-then60: Prelife Log shows two SYS→POS→LRU paths with leaf ages20/60; first original-item PMs are staggered at h80/h40.
hypothesis_before_native.age60-then20: Swapping only leaf ages reverses which mother has h40 versus h80 first item PM, while aggregate demand remains one event at each hour. Numeric system and physical item ID mapping is native observation.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Both arms exact-roundtrip populated authored tables, convert with zero errors/notes and only known event-log #108 warning, calculate without unreviewed runtime errors, seal source/raw evidence and preserve GUI PID13340 and registry option NO. Any added warning requires review.

The pair differs only in the two leaf PrelifeData.AGE cells 20↔60 and description. Common parent construction creates two SYS PLINDs with separate POS and LRU prelife paths, but leaves material structure, monitored PM, one spare, IQTY0 and horizon identical.

Native Prelife Log separately lists two SYS→POS→LRU paths and their respective leaf ages; first original installed item PMs occur once at h40 and once at h80, with the associated mother assignment reversed between arms. Physical item IDs and replacement route are checked from native logs rather than assumed.
Each arm has 192 contiguous half-hour System/Stock bins, no missions or resource booking, and conserved physical stock with terminal ready two systems. Event and report ledgers reconcile.
A separate reviewer independently replays source and raw evidence without importing author validation code.
limits: Two same-type mother systems, one position and installed LRU per system, one spare, CALHOURS, one seed and first monitored item PMs only. No general mapping law for additional systems or mixed types.
Stocked-item prelife, later PM cycles, other OPIDs, GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity are unverified.
